qa.q: Is there anything special about the villages in your country?
qa.a: Not that I'm aware of, although they could be made up of materials or in particular styles that are unique to the area, something like sandstone for example.

qa.q: Why do people want to go to the countryside?
qa.a: For starters it's a nice escape from the rat race in cities so they might go to decompress before returning to that. Another thing that comes to mind is having some sort of romantic ideal of the peaceful countryside in general that draws them there, not just to visit but to live. Whether that's true or not is another matter entirely but those are some of the reasons.

qa.q: What do people usually do when they visit a village?
qa.a: Well your guess is as good as mine. Villages are pretty diverse in terms of what they offer. I mean if it's just a smattering of houses then there's possibly not much to do but sit and read a book or something like that. Conversely there may be local tourist attractions like waterfalls or hiking routes or even festivals that people can enjoy but that's not always certain and some places are just really quiet and they like being that way.

qa.q: Will more people live in villages in the future?
qa.a: Well the sort of demographic trend has always been increasing migration from the countryside to the cities since that's where the work and opportunities are and that doesn't show much sign of slowing down or reversing so I'd say no.

qa.q: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in the countryside?
qa.a: We covered a few already but the main ones are probably things like having more space and supposedly cleaner or healthier living since the downsides of towns and cities are rarely present in such cases.

qa.q: What kind of people would like to stay in the countryside?
qa.a: I mean well people who want to enjoy the advantages and don't mind too much about the downsides. It's hard to think of specific personality traits but I imagine people who don't like change and value their own space would rather spend their time there than people who don't share those kinds of traits.

qa.q: Do people in your country like to go hiking?
qa.a: Well there certainly seems to be a big demand for it and this makes sense since we have lots of mountains and mountain trails.
